issue.title: Implement Cross-Granularity Playback with Stitching and Labeling
issue.body: When a translator switches display mode, existing recordings may have been made at the other granularity. Rather than blocking playback, the app always plays what exists: verse recordings are stitched together for pericope-level playback, and a pericope recording viewed at verse level is labeled to show the range it covers. This ticket implements that cross-granularity playback behavior. ## Functional Requirements ### Verse-to-Pericope Playback - When a project's recordings were made verse-by-verse and the user switches to pericope view, stitch the consecutive verse recordings together for pericope-level playback. - Label the stitched row's take card subtitle "Take [N] - Stitched - vv. [X]-[Y]", in place of the plain granularity tag from #410. - A stitched recording only takes up on recording slot. - A stitched recording cannot be deleted from pericope view. ### Pericope-to-Verse Playback - When a pericope take exists and the user switches to verse view, show that take on every verse row it covers, using the take card subtitle already defined in #410 ("Take [N] - Pericope - vv. [X]-[Y]"). - Always state the pericope's true verse range in full in that subtitle, never truncated, even when the range extends beyond the verses currently visible. - This full-range label is sufficient on its own; no separate "partial" indicator is needed here, since a pericope take by definition covers its whole range once it exists. ### Playback Behavior - Play the full recording whenever a stitched or labeled recording is tapped; no partial or segmented playback. - When a pericope has only some of its verses recorded, play the recorded verses in order and stop, in pericope-mode playback. - Show a distinct "partially recorded" status indicator for a pericope with incomplete verse coverage, rather than the standard recorded checkmark. > **Note:** The "partially recorded" indicator is built in #408. > **Note 2:** The take card subtitle format and its interaction with the 5-take cap are owned by #410 (Support Mixed-Mode Recording with Cross-Granularity Take Labeling) — this ticket's verse-row display depends on that labeling existing, and this ticket only adds the new "Stitched" label for pericope-view rows composed from verse takes.

comments.body:
## Engineering context

### Product intent
When display mode doesn’t match how takes were recorded, still play what exists: stitch consecutive verse takes for pericope-level playback (label `Take [N] - Stitched - vv. [X]-[Y]`); show pericope takes on each covered verse with the #410 subtitle (full range, never truncated); play full recordings (or recorded verses in order for partial coverage).

### What exists today
- Playback is per-take via `useVerseAudio` / playback engine — no stitch playlist helper.
- No cross-granularity take model until #410.
- Bible “partially recorded” indicator is owned by **#408** (this ticket consumes that state for playback rules).

### Alignment notes
- Prefer client-side stitching of local verse take URIs (sequential play through the engine) over inventing a server-side stitch artifact.
- Pericope-on-verse rows reuse #410 labeling; this ticket only **adds** the `Stitched` subtitle variant for synthetic pericope rows.
- Partial coverage in pericope mode: play recorded verses in order and stop — not a separate “partial play” scrubber.
- Full-range subtitle even when the visible chapter is a subset — needs full pericope verse list (same API/sync gap as #408).

### Suggested approach
1. Depend on #410 take model + labels.
2. Build a small pure helper: given mode + takes + pericope map → display rows (real takes vs stitched aggregates) + subtitle kind.
3. Wire playback: single take play vs ordered stitch queue; stop cleanly between units.
4. Hook partial indicator from #408 for Bible cards; Record list follows #410/#411 labels.

### Dependencies
- **Requires:** #410 (labels + cap + shared takes), #407, pericope sync, #408 indicator for Bible partial state.
- Player baseline #412 is helpful for source audio but not required for draft-take stitching.

### API
- No new API required for **local** stitch playback.
- Still inherits #410’s need for range-take upload if pericope/stitched takes must sync to server.
- Full-range labels inherit the chapter-pericopes full-span gap noted on #408.

### Out of scope
- Building the partial indicator chrome (#408)
- 5-take cap rules (#410)
- Settings toggle (#407)

@Roslin22, Nightly QA checklist — #411 Cross-granularity Stitched playback
PR: https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/506
Checklist generated with AI assistance.

Setup
- Project with a pericope set.
- In Verse mode, record takes on at least vv. 3 and 4 of a chapter.
- Settings → Drafting unit = Pericope → open Record on that chapter.

Checklist
1. Tap Play on the Stitched row; do not touch controls until playback ends (segments play in order).
2. Play again; Pause during segment 1 → wait 5s → Play (stays in-segment; no auto-advance while paused).
3. Play into segment 2; Pause during segment 2 → Play.
4. Let playback finish; wave and timer reset to 0:00.
5. Record or play a real Pericope take row (trash icon present); pause mid-playback, then resume. Wave freezes on pause.
6. Verse mode regression: two verse takes — select, play, seek, delete.
7. Play a pericope take row to completion (no cut-out / no stray stitched segments).
8. Offline: stitch still plays from local takes.

Pass when: Stitched row is labeled like “Take N - Stitched - vv. 3-4” (play only; no trash/select). Segment progress resets at boundaries; pause/resume works across segments; verse mode unchanged; no crash on verse nav, record start, or delete during stitch.

Also from Matt’s review on the PR:
- Full matrix above: stitched pause/resume across segment boundaries, pericope take row vs Stitched row, verse-mode regression, delete/record while a segment load is in flight
- Quick smoke if already in pericope mode: source-audio waveform ticks (out of #411 scope; plain scrubber OK when no verseTimestamps)

**Test Results : #411**

- Verse-to-Pericope Playback: Verified that consecutive verse recordings are stitched together and played continuously in pericope mode. The stitched take is displayed with the “Take [N] - Stitched - vv. [X]-[Y]” label.
- Stitched Recording Slot: Verified that the stitched recording occupies one recording slot and is not counted as multiple recordings.
- Stitched Recording Deletion: Verified that the stitched recording cannot be deleted from pericope view.
- Pericope-to-Verse Playback: Verified that a pericope recording is displayed on every verse it covers when switching to verse mode. The take is labeled with the complete pericope verse range.
- Cross-Chapter Pericope: Verified that a pericope spanning a chapter boundary displays its full verse range in the take label, including verses from both chapters.
- Full Playback: Verified that tapping a stitched or labeled recording plays the full available recording, rather than only the selected verse or a partial segment.
- Partial Recording: Verified that when only some verses in a pericope are recorded, the available recordings play in order and the pericope shows a “Partially Recorded” status instead of the normal recorded checkmark.
- Playback Duration: Verified the playback timer for stitched recordings.
- Verified with different users in the same chapter. The playback displays correctly for different takes

**Issue identified:** The playback timer resets to 0 when the stitched recording moves to the next verse. It should continue from the previous verse’s time.
I am ok with the timer resetting to 0 since it is a stitched recording. That kind of reinforces that it is stitched. :white_check_mark:
